Reference Notes & FAQ

Does Wise add a markup to the exchange rate?

No. Wise uses the real mid-market exchange rate and charges an upfront transparent fixed + variable percentage fee depending on the currency corridor.

Why is there a fixed fee on USD SWIFT wires?

International SWIFT transfers involve correspondent banks, which adds a small fixed rail fee compared to local ACH transfers.
